elements.description: Every agent as a lane on a live timeline, with decisions in place.

properties.name: agents
properties.description: The agents, one lane each from top to bottom – name, model and an optional avatar

properties.name: tasks
properties.description:
The tasks – always the source of truth. After Approve or Reject the block shows the result right away; as soon as
you pass that task with a new status, start or end, your version wins

properties.name: span
properties.description: How much time the lanes show, in ms (default 30 minutes)

properties.name: now
properties.description: A clock you control, in epoch ms. Without it the lanes follow real time

properties.name: rate
properties.description:
How fast the clock runs, in clock ms per real ms: on from `now` when set (default 0), from real time otherwise
(default 1)

properties.name: onApprove
properties.description: Called on Approve – may return a promise the decision waits for

properties.name: onReject
properties.description: Called on Reject – may return a promise the decision waits for

properties.name: openable
properties.description: Shows "Open" in a block's details; pressing it fires tc-open

properties.name: paused
properties.description:
Whether the timeline is held still. Changed by the Pause button unless a tc-paused-change listener calls
preventDefault(). The lanes also hold still while the pointer or focus is on them (WCAG 2.2.2)

properties.name: expanded
properties.description:
The id of the block whose decision or details are open (null: none). Changed by the user unless a
tc-expanded-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The title on the summary bar

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-expanded-change
events.description: A block's decision or details open or close ({ expanded: string | null }); cancelable

events.name: tc-paused-change
events.description: The Pause button holds or resumes the timeline ({ paused: boolean }); cancelable

events.name: tc-open
events.description: "Open" in a block's details was pressed ({ task: LaneTask }); shown when `openable` is set

props.name: agents
props.description: The agents, one lane each from top to bottom; avatars can be React nodes

props.name: tasks
props.description:
The tasks – always the source of truth. After Approve or Reject the block shows the result right away; as soon
as you pass that task with a new status, start or end, your version wins

props.name: onApprove
props.description: Called on Approve in a waiting task's decision – may return a promise the decision waits for

props.name: onReject
props.description: Called on Reject in a waiting task's decision – may return a promise the decision waits for

props.name: paused
props.description: Whether the timeline is held still (controlled)

props.name: defaultPaused
props.description: Whether the timeline starts held still, when `paused` isn't set

props.name: onPausedChange
props.description: Called when the Pause button is pressed, with the new paused state

props.name: expanded
props.description: The id of the block whose decision or tooltip is open. Controlled when defined (null = none)

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: The block open at first, when `expanded` isn't set

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Called with a block's id when its decision or details open, and null when they close

props.name: title
props.description: The title on the summary bar – "Agents" by default
